items.title: Add a post-lock, pre-merge mainSha re-check that aborts DONE before persist on external main advance
items.context: In handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts, inside the main-write-lock, after autoSyncMain and BEFORE the merge that precedes the phase=DONE persist (~line 431), re-read mains current sha and compare to the sha the DONE pre-check synced against. If it changed (external git advance), abort with a clear re-run story_advance DONE to resync message, leaving the story at TEST (no phase mutation, no partial merge). Do NOT add after-DONE auto-retry; do NOT change the existing main-write-lock.

happy.desc: With main unchanged inside the lock, story_advance DONE proceeds and reaches DONE with the normal merge (no abort; happy path byte-identical).

edge.desc: An external main advance between autoSyncMain and the persist makes story_advance DONE abort with the resync message BEFORE store.writeStory; the persisted phase stays TEST.
On abort, NO phase=DONE is written and NO merge commit lands on main (no partial DONE).

adversarial.desc: The baseline sha is captured AFTER autoSyncMain, so Lattice own pre-check sync does not false-positive the abort.
The abort throw releases the main-write-lock via the existing try/finally, so subsequent DONEs are not deadlocked.

items.userSees: On an external main advance mid-DONE, `lattice story_advance --phase=DONE` prints "DONE aborted: main advanced (<old7> -> <new7>) after the pre-check sync; nothing was merged and the story stays at TEST. Re-run story_advance DONE to resync." and the story phase is still TEST (no partial merge). With main unchanged in-lock, DONE merges normally.

items.title: Smoke for the pre-merge mainSha abort path
items.context: Add a smoke (packages/main/src/tasks/*-smoke.ts, auto-discovered) + npm wiring: simulate an external advance to main between the pre-check sync and the in-lock merge -> story_advance DONE aborts cleanly at TEST with the resync hint, NO phase=DONE persisted, NO partial merge; the happy path (main unchanged in-lock) still merges and reaches DONE.

happy.desc: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-premerge-mainsha-recheck-smoke.js exits 0 and reports all checks passed.

edge.desc: Full npm test exits 0 with the new smoke included in the suite.

adversarial.desc: The smoke is non-vacuous: with the re-check present an external advance aborts (phase stays TEST, no phase=DONE, no merge commit) AND the unchanged-main happy path still reaches DONE — i.e. the smoke would fail if the re-check were removed or placed after the persist.

items.userSees: node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-premerge-mainsha-recheck-smoke.js prints its checks and exits 0; full npm test exits 0 with the new smoke included.
